notes:
Scale ~1.53 px/ft (200 ft/in). No bracketed old names seen. Printed without a suffix on this half: DIXMYTH, JOSELIN, PROBASCO, GIRAUD, DECKEBACH, BADER, GILMORE, STRAIGHT (HOPPLE ST., RACHEL ST., TOWNSHIP ST. carry one): Dixmyth Avenue and Joselin Avenue as given by the caller, Giraud Avenue and Probasco Street from the suffixes printed on 35R, Deckebach Avenue (usual name), the rest Street. McMicken printed W. McMICKEN AVE. (recorded West McMicken Avenue, as on 16R).
Gilmore Street: the old Miami & Erie canal bed and Gilmore are drawn as one undivided strip between lot lines. Hopple-Rachel it is ~110 ft wide at Hopple tapering to ~70 ft and printed only 'STREET' (34R prints 'ST.'); Rachel-Bader it is printed OLD BED / MIAMI AND ERIE CANAL; south of Bader OLD BED and GILMORE side by side. Taken as Gilmore Street throughout because house numbers on the east side (2850 near Bader ... 2948-2980 near Hopple) continue Gilmore's. (In 1904 a separate Gourd Street ran along the west bank Hopple-Rachel; 34R prints GOURD north of Hopple.) Points at Hopple, Rachel and Bader use the middle of the strip; at Marshall, where the bed swings west into a wide triangle, Gilmore proper (4 in pipe, ~20 ft off the east lots). Alternatives if Gilmore is taken as only the east ~40 ft along the lots: Hopple ~(1720,2475), Rachel ~(1890,3166), Bader ~(2148,4640). The big SAMUEL M. RIDDLE...PER SHERIFF lettering across the hillside blocks is a subdivision name, not a street.
Riddle Road zigzags: NE diagonal from McMicken, E-W piece printed ROAD, short N-S jog printed 'ST.', SE diagonal, then E-W printed RIDDLE to the right edge; house numbers run continuously (731... 692, 685-667, 664...), so one street.
Water pipes are drawn as solid lines crossing the mouths of side streets (Dixmyth, Straight, Probasco, Riddle); points use block corners, not those lines. Coloured subdivision bands lie along the street side of block lines.
Foulke Street in two pieces: west piece (Riddle jog to a lot line) and east piece (Taylor to Marshall); nothing between. Bader in two pieces offset ~70 px: west (Massachusetts-Cormany-old bed, ends there), east (Gilmore-McMicken). Ravine Street in two offset pieces at Straight. Wagner continues south of Straight as Luna Avenue; University Court continues as Fairview Avenue. Giraud's south line is not drawn between Enslin and Ravine (side-street lines run to its north line); centre taken from its 60 ft width.
Drawn area stops (not real ends): Hopple and Rachel at x~1290-1300, Township and Marshall at the left, Cormany north of y~3100, Massachusetts north of y~3800, McMicken north of y~950, Morrison and Whitfield at the top, Luna/Ravine/Westview/Fairview stubs at y~7100. Dixmyth, Riddle, Probasco, Joselin, Giraud and Straight run off the right edge. No Clifton Avenue on this half.
Gutter ties with 35R (35R x ~ 35L x - 5690): Kenelm/Probasco, Kenelm/Joselin, Kenelm/Giraud, Westview/Straight, University Court/Fortune, University Court/Straight, Fairview/Straight.
Not recorded: unnamed ~20 ft sewer strip north of Hopple at x~1690; 'DED. FOR STREET PURPOSES' strip x~5590-5640 north of Riddle; 'AL.' alleys south of Hull; 'SOUTH/NORTH LINE OF LOT 60' survey lines; 'W ST.' fragment by Cormany's south end (looks like owner text).
